name: An Enticing Offer

angles.text: As an herbalist, you know duskweed as a troublesome local plant with toxic petals. Handle it carefully when gathering it for bait.
As a hunter, you know the bait can harm domestic beasts and hunting companions if they eat it.

faq.answer: Remy asks you to gather duskweed and make toxic bait to deter nearby murlocs. The gathering also helps farmers clear the weed from their fields.
faq.q: What is the quest An Enticing Offer?

faq.answer: Duskweed is a persistent weed in local farm fields. Its petals are toxic to most beasts in substantial quantities, making them useful in bait meant to deter murlocs.
The plan uses bait made with toxic duskweed petals to teach local murlocs to avoid the area instead of trying to exterminate them.
faq.q: How is the murloc bait intended to work?

faq.answer: Jason is the fisherman who sent you to Remy about his murloc trouble. Remy says to warn Jason not to eat the duskweed bait.
Yes. Duskweed petals are toxic to most animals in substantial quantities. Keep domestic animals and pets away from the mixture.
faq.q: Is the murloc bait dangerous to other creatures?

faq.answer: Duskweed aggressively invades cultivated fields and troubles local growers. Gathering it clears the fields and provides the ingredient for bait against murlocs.
faq.q: Why is gathering duskweed considered a win-win?

sections.body: Remy has a plan for two local troubles. You gather duskweed from nearby fields, where it troubles the growers, then use it to make bait meant to keep murlocs from settled lands. The plan is to teach the murlocs to avoid the weed.
sections.title: A Twofold Solution

sections.body: Duskweed is both the heart of the bait and a persistent weed in nearby farm plots. Its petals harm most beasts when gathered in substantial quantities. Gathering it from troubled farmers clears an aggressive plant from their fields and supplies the base for bait meant to steer murloc packs away.
sections.title: The Nature of Duskweed

sections.body: Duskweed makes the bait hazardous to handle because its toxins harm other creatures too. Keep domestic animals and pets away from the mixture. Remy also warns you to make sure Jason does not mistake the pungent bait for a meal.
sections.title: Baiting the Waters

summary: Remy asks you to gather duskweed for bait against nearby murlocs. Clearing it may also help local farmers.
